title: S&P 500 - Oppenheimer raised its year-end target to 5900, from 5500 previously
text:
S&P 500 - Oppenheimer raised its year-end target to 5900, from 5500 previously news Eamonn Sheridan 08/07/2024 | 22:29 GMT , published 08/07/2024 at 10:29 PM Tags spx Add as a preferred source on Google Equity researchers Oppenheimer: We
are increasing our year-end target price for the S&P 500 to
$5,900 (from $5,500) and raising our earnings projection to $255 from
$250 for the S&P 500 in 2024. Our upwardly-adjusted price target
and earnings projection assume a higher P/E multiple of 23.1x up from
22x with our earlier target Earlier re the S&P 500: US stocks - Q2 earnings season about to kick off - UBS looking for solidly higher Morgan Stanley's Wilson says a 10% fall in S&P 500 by US election is 'highly likely' Your market education doesn't end here.
